top_choice_rationale: P001 awards a single-part prize to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov for the physiology of GLP-1 and its active form. The mechanism is mature and stable (proglucagon processing, insulinotropic action of GLP-1(7-36), degradation-resistant agonists), independent trials have confirmed the effect on glycaemia, weight and cardiorenal outcomes, and the discovery fits one citation sentence. The trio covers secretion and action in humans, receptor and metabolic biology, and identification of the active form without a fourth name. No award is a clearly weaker outcome given this maturity.
